meta.abstraction: Finite user-visible projection of sampled valid traces; merged predicates may over-approximate combinations of hidden preconditions. This is not exhaustive model checking.
meta.emissionReview: The published fact accompanies the upstream domain change; reopening or reprojecting a screen must not emit it again.

meta.description: The person is opening the account sign in view.
checks: No final outcome is claimed before the opening result.

meta.description: The person is viewing the guest account.
checks: No account ever loses its last sign-in method (so Alice never has more accounts than outside accounts).
An account has at most one outside account per sign-in method.
Devices are signed in only to accounts that exist.
An online device shows whether it is signed in as everyone else knows it; an offline one may still show signed in after it was signed out, never the reverse.
An online device shows the sign-in methods everyone else knows. An offline device keeps the ones it last saw. A device that is not signed in shows none.
meta.projectionReview: Confirm that omitted data do not enable an impossible stitched path.
